details: The North Korean cyber-espionage group Kimsuky is reportedly integrating artificial intelligence into its cyberattacks, specifically targeting cryptocurrency and financial institutions globally. This marks an evolving threat landscape for the digital asset sector.
title: North Korea's Kimsuky Group Uses AI in Crypto Cyberattacks

details: Robinhood has expanded its cryptocurrency trading services to its main app in the United Kingdom. This expansion is facilitated through a partnership with Bitstamp, making crypto assets more accessible to UK users.
title: Robinhood Launches Crypto Trading in UK via Bitstamp

details: Brazil is set to introduce stricter controls on cryptocurrency fraud, including a new 24-hour waiting period for transfers of digital assets to self-custody wallets. This measure aims to enhance security and prevent illicit activities.
title: Brazil Implements 24-Hour Wait for Crypto Transfers

details: Approximately $7.9 million has been drained from Coinsbuy exchange wallets across both the Ethereum and TRON blockchains in a recent security breach. This incident highlights ongoing security vulnerabilities in the crypto space.
title: $7.9M Drained from Coinsbuy Wallets on Ethereum & TRON

details: Crypto Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs) for Bitcoin and Ethereum collectively saw $1.1 billion in inflows over the past week, marking their strongest performance since April. This surge occurred despite generally lower trading volumes across the broader market.
title: Bitcoin & Ethereum ETFs Attract $1.1B, Best Week Since April

details: Over the past 24 hours, Ethereum experienced $49.8 million in liquidations, with short positions accounting for $40.7 million. This indicates a significant squeeze on bearish traders as the price moved against their short positions.
title: Ethereum Sees $49.8M Liquidations, Shorts Dominate

details: Large Ethereum (ETH) investors, or "whales," have been observed actively accumulating ETH over the past two days. A significant amount, including 19,000 ETH, was withdrawn from exchanges like Gemini and directed into staking contracts, signaling long-term confidence.
title: Ethereum Whales Accumulate ETH, Deploy to Staking
